### 🚀 v7.7.0 — Minor Release (Quotes Dashboard Request AbortController & Cache Pruning, Quotation Mistakes Automation & Leave Overrides) (Current)

- **Quotes Dashboard Request AbortController & Request Sequencing**: Integrated active `AbortController` and monotonic request sequence IDs (`fetchSeqRef`) into the quotations pipeline. Rapidly clicking or changing Month/Year filters immediately aborts obsolete in-flight HTTP requests, preventing stale network responses from overwriting newer user selections.
- **Background Cache Pruning**: Implemented background pruning for IndexedDB records cache to keep local storage lightweight and high-performing without blocking the main render thread.
- **Optimized Date Formatting & Record Filtering**: Cached Asia/Dhaka (+06:00) date part calculations and memoized filter matchers to eliminate redundant CPU cycles during bulk table rendering.
- **Quotation Mistakes Intelligence**: Added smart default period computation and automated filter initialization, guaranteeing accurate historical mistake tracking across all user roles.
- **Leave Settings & Per-User Overrides**: Added merged mode support, custom annual leave overrides, and dynamic per-user leave settings resolution.
- **Realtime State Synchronization**: Enhanced profile and leave update emissions across UserManagement and DashboardModals for instant reactive UI updates.
